events.verdict: Walsh (BOS) firms up over his right leg in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Edwards (PHI) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Walsh (BOS) is moving alongside Maxey's (PHI) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Walsh (BOS) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot attempt.

As Brown (BOS) raises the ball up, his upper body/shoulder makes contact with Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) head.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) briefly grasps Queta's (BOS) arm before immediately releasing him as they disengage.
Edgecombe (PHI) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Walsh (BOS) moves slightly towards Maxey (PHI) as he defends the drive and Maxey maintains his desired path to the basket.
Walsh (BOS) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) driving shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards Brown (BOS) and initiates contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Drummond (PHI) firms up over his right leg in Walsh's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
Brown (BOS) contests Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) shot at the rim, and the contact to Oubre Jr.'s right arm/shoulder is marginal.
Drummond (PHI) makes contact with the part of White's (BOS) hand that is on the ball and cleanly dislodges the ball.
Drummond (PHI) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
